basic_info.description: On a highly coveted cul-de-sac in San Francisco, this luxurious 2 or 3 bedroom Russian Hill home(6 rooms, 2 bath per SF Assessor)in move-in condition, features sweeping views of the San Francisco Bay, Alcatraz, Coit Tower, Bay Bridge & Downtown. It stays true to its Bay Area Mid-century Modern architectural roots while reaping the benefits of modernization & extensive renovation. The main level open floor plan is drenched in natural light with large windows & the ease of indoor-outdoor flow. The grand living room, dining room, chef's kitchen & terrace celebrate the delights of memorable gatherings. The pent level features a primary bedroom, an ensuite retreat with spacious WIC & light-filled drawing room with fireplace. The views are stunning & continue to delight with direct access to a large roof deck. The lower level is a testament to flexibility, 2 rooms enjoyed as bedrooms, family room, music/art studio or office, complete with full bathroom. The semi-detached home has a separate side entrance ideal for guest quarters & privacy.  The luxury of this home extends to the outdoors, with a backyard blooming with lush greenery & a chic pebble patio. Practicality meets convenience with 2-car sxs garage parking. In this home, life is not just lived; it is savored every moment.
